points.description: Names at least three of the four irrigation methods: sprinkler, drip, furrow, flood (any wording, e.g. surface/basin/border flooding for flood).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for naming two correct methods (or one if vague but on track).

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming about three of the four methods (sprinkler, drip, furrow, flood) in any wording. Give 1 mark for two correct methods. Give 0 if no correct method is named. Extra or wrong items do not cost marks.
